excerpt: ACL readers may remember Bambi OFS (Cédric Dambrain) from the hyperkinetic EP Yakka. Since then, the Brussels artist has released the EP Kwon-9, whose remixes fleshed it out to the length of an LP, and now Minke. Should one wish, one might view these releases as a trilogy.

Humor, play, fun. These words are bandied about in the press release for The Endless Dance, a sky blue LP that sparkles like spring. The vibrant template of the cover suggests an array of flowers bursting from the earth, the artists cleverly disguised in the collage.
Imagine living in the "best town," a rural community of friendly neighbors surrounded by natural beauty, and then having to leave it behind.
